result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **HubSpot CRM** as the best all-round starting point. However, if your team is primarily focused on sales, **Pipedrive** might actually be the better choice.

The right CRM depends on whether you need to manage leads, sales, customer relationships, marketing or all of the above.

## My top 5 CRM recommendations

**1\. HubSpot CRM**

(Best overall)

- Excellent free starting plan
- Contact management and sales pipelines
- Email tracking and integrations
- Marketing and automation capabilities

Best for teams wanting an all-in-one platform.

[HubSpot website](https://www.hubspot.com/products/crm)

**2\. Pipedrive**

(Best for sales teams)

- Very intuitive visual sales pipeline
- Excellent deal tracking
- Follow-up reminders
- Easy for a small team to adopt

Best for businesses managing enquiries, opportunities and sales.

[Pipedrive website](https://www.pipedrive.com/)

---

![TheProwess | Zoho CRM'de Yeni Dönem: Eski Arayüz 15 Temmuz'da Tamamen Kaldırılıyor](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/mhOzD_IXTeMyjegHs7_31H-nZlvGoIQWY2PfiTmHpwuQOA09A9NutmTAM8TWT2HF-7JryptkgV-lS_xHcaI7d43ujbBUTvqfxj-z3nk-gdRQr3-Ei-qigHIPik-T14ytWC4EuYLl0he93dU9qCw5sHTS1LPdprZuUjTWv0UHX5wzcmxSTdtKBrPPwq-xdGBE?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Zoho CRM**

- Great value for money
- Strong automation
- Highly customisable
- Free plan for up to three users

Best for businesses wanting more functionality without spending much.

[Zoho CRM website](https://www.zoho.com/crm/)

---

![Descargar Freshsales CRM varies-with-device para Web Apps - Filehippo.com](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ymGWkXtkAC7MoWysGML3OKgHF9O0MPKH1PfAAeDjk1aaZrRWaVBb9r5y-Kf_8j4xYqKU0KB7QvzLaYT0HE0Vv7VVhtrsyXiqQzkmNrQWCEXFxliHIByLJsgnf2ztG74VQ6KpL_qyhXQE--CUkaD3WIbFGDInuBn5hMKNEjmTwahJ5xR1Qf4y9c43huoiOovk?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Freshsales**

- CRM with built-in communication tools
- Lead scoring and automation
- Email, phone and chat functionality

Best for teams that spend lots of time communicating with prospects.

[Freshsales website](https://www.freshworks.com/crm/sales/)

---

![monday.com Products](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/rL9Bzm932Es-G8eSD-IugxH25VpIFj2GrnbBExwUqA2Nr3S2F-13Q2QUuWHSsw5hSYAN9ENyOY_MTevU9OZtOiwp-cUhvAnLAqY_40r6pFQsW3KxPgFxL3JCosxfn4L6Jfwp2NCZNME-i2pDOLdg2P_TmFE26A6QIif7ztMuqYUxcMfuJMeKmmPBjbxzqwot?purpose=fullsize)

- Flexible visual dashboards
- Sales and task management
- Good team collaboration
- Custom workflows

Best for teams wanting CRM and project management together.
